about: E1 golden values (design §3.7), recorded on the v1 engine and renderer at the learn-v2 base, before any learn code changed. Hashes and counts only, no entity ID. Recipe: learn/tests/golden.py. page_sha256 is golden.page_sha() of site/dist/learn/hijrah-step-by-step/index.html built by site/build.py then learn/build_learn.py on build/graph.ttl: every href and id attribute value blanked, whitespace runs collapsed, sha256 of the UTF-8 text. content_sha is the Hijrah journey's content digest (design §9) in the marsad-journey export (site/dist/learn/data/journeys/hijrah-step-by-step/journey.json), recorded in stage C on the graph whose stage-A gate values (content_v1_gate, golden.content_facts(): ordered step pids, each step's entity fields, every claim about a step or behind a reason) matched. The gate is an input, the graph's fingerprint (graph.fingerprint), never an output of the learn code under test (golden.e1_gate): while the export's graph fingerprint equals it, the content_sha, content_v1_gate and page_sha(held_page(page)) of the v2 Study page must all equal the values here, so a learn change that alters any of them fails; once the fingerprint differs the golden test skips with 're-verify E1'. A graph change in blank nodes only, which the fingerprint cannot see (design §17, item 10), fails too: re-verify E1 and record new values. golden.held_page() is the one statement of what a held page may add (design §3.7 and §8): it takes out nav.journey-depths, the empty s-* anchor spans, and the data-depth, data-total and data-steps attributes of <article>; base-relative links need nothing, as page_sha blanks every href value. Anything else a held page adds, or any other change to it, fails the test.
